author: Inyo Register
title: Dear Narcissist is now an Amazon bestseller available in ebook and paperback
text:
Dear Narcissist: A Bold, No-Nonsense Guide to Breaking Free from Narcissists and Reclaiming Your Power is now an Amazon bestseller after its launch party on April 29th, 2025.
Sara Al Madani, a globally recognized public speaker, award-winning entrepreneur and 4x TEDx speaker, announces the release of her latest book, Dear Narcissist—a daring, unfiltered, and transformative guide that shatters the conventional approach to understanding narcissists and the lasting impact they can have on our lives. This is not your typical self-help book.
Al Madani takes readers on a raw, emotional journey of unmasking narcissists and breaking free from their grip. Having lived through four narcissistic relationships, two toxic marriages, financial betrayal, spiritual breakdowns, and emotional manipulation—all while building businesses and raising a child—she has lived through the trauma and come out the other side stronger, wiser, and ready to teach others how to do the same.
Dear Narcissist offers clarity, trauma-informed wisdom, and actionable strategies for anyone who has ever wondered, “Was it me?” after leaving a narcissist’s wreckage. This powerful book is a field manual for those seeking to understand the narcissist’s tactics, gain insight into how narcissists operate, and ultimately, heal from the emotional and spiritual damage caused by their presence.
In her book, Sara teaches readers how to:
• Recognize the types of narcissists (and how they shape-shift)
• Identify the red flags they missed—and never will again
• Spot narcissists by their energy, tone, and body language • Navigate relationships with narcissists in the workplace, in families, or as co-parents
• Take back their power and heal their nervous system
• Understand what truly scares narcissists (and how to eliminate fear forever)
A departure from clinical, theory-driven approaches, Dear Narcissist is a spiritual and emotional bootcamp. It arms readers with the tools to stop self-blame, shed confusion, and reclaim their strength. Sara Al Madani’s journey is a testament to resilience. From founding 21 companies—nine of which are now thriving on the global stage—to overcoming personal, professional, and existential breakdowns, Sara has been shaped by fire. Her business mind and spiritual heart are the driving forces behind her ability to inspire and transform lives. A single mother, spiritual powerhouse, and woman who has risen from collapse time and time again. Sara now advises top corporations, speaks globally, and helps individuals tap into their inherent power. She believes that success is rooted in self-worth, and through her guidance, people are learning to trust their intuition, align their energy, and create the lives they desire. With over 150 keynote speeches and more than 110 awards to her name, Sara Al Madani’s impact goes beyond titles and accolades. Her real story is about overcoming obstacles, embracing the power of self-love, and using each breakdown as fuel for reinvention.
Dear Narcissist: A Bold, No-Nonsense Guide to Breaking Free from Narcissists and Reclaiming Your Power is available now on Amazon in ebook and paperback:
https://www.amazon.com/Dear-Narcissist-Spotting-Escaping-Narcissistic-ebook/dp/B0F4Y7424Y
For media inquiries, interviews, and speaking engagements, please contact: hi@sara-almadani.com
Sara Al Madani is an entrepreneur, investor, speaker, and author with a rare combination of strategic brilliance and deep spiritual insight. She is the founder of 9 businesses across various industries and an advocate for leadership grounded in healing and self-worth. A single mother and spiritual teacher, Sara Al Madani helps others reclaim their power, overcome challenges, and rise to their fullest potential.
Sara’s retreat the Amara Experiences is more than just a getaway—it’s a soul activation. Rooted in her core belief that true healing comes from within, these retreats are designed to help people remember their own power. Sara doesn’t heal people—she reflects their truth back to them so they can become their own healers. Held in sacred locations around the world every few months, these immersive experiences are built on five pillars: transformation, community, safety, love, and ancient wisdom. Each retreat offers a unique theme—from identity alchemy to spiritual awakening—but the intention is always the same: We gather to rise. We gather to transform. We gather to remember who we really are.
